> "The essential nature of light is reflective awareness (vimarśa); otherwise light, though
> 'coloured' by objects, would be similar to an insentient reality, such as crystal and so
> on."
> Vṛtti: "Reflective awareness (pratyavamarśa) constitutes the primary essence (mukhya
> ātman) of light. In the absence of this reflective awareness, light, though objects make
> it assume different forms, would merely be 'limpid', but not sentient, since there is no
> 'savouring' (camatkṛteḥ)."
